Minor'S Compromise Hearing
Off Calendar Mar-04-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing on Compromise of a Disputed Claim of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

David G. Yen, Esq. appeared with petitioner Eric Stephens, who was present as Guardian ad litem for Jonathan Malachi Stephens, a minor Claimant, who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and testified.

On the basis of evidence received, and good cause appearing, the Petition is granted and compromise is approved.

Settlement Amount - $10,000.00.
Attorney's Fees - $2,359.21.
Medical Expenses - $0.00.
Costs - $563.17.
A net balance of $7,077.62 shall be invested in a single-premium deferred annuity subject to withdrawal only on Order of the Court. The terms and conditions of the annuity are specified in Attachment 16a(3), a copy of which is attached to the Order Approving Compromise of a Disputed Claim of a Minor.

Order Approving Compromise of a Disputed Claim of a Minor was submitted to and signed by the Court.
